entities.summary: Huang Binhong was a Chinese literati painter and art historian born in Jinhua, Zhejiang province. His ancestral home was She County, Anhui province. He was the grandson of artist Huang Fengliu. He would later be associated with Shanghai and finally Hangzhou. He is considered one of the last innovators in the literati style of painting and is noted for his freehand landscapes. Huang Binhong was a writers & intellectuals from Jinhua (1865-01-27, Jinhua–1955-03-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
